caption:
Your role feels unbearable to hold? It was never yours to carry. (1 Timothy 1:12 devotional)

The role feels unbearable because we hold it as ours — a load we shoulder alone or a kingdom we built. Paul held his as entrusted. A steward carries the task, not the crushing weight of owning it.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
